verdict.rationale: Railway documents built-in custom dashboards with metrics from any service, plus centralized logs, which partly covers tracking performance. Nothing in the evidence shows visitor-behavior or web analytics such as pageviews, sessions or user journeys, so only the performance half is thinly supported. Missing for 10: visitor-behavior/traffic analytics, site-level performance metrics (e.g. page load or web vitals), detail on which metrics the dashboards expose, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I can track site performance and visitor behavior with built-in analytics

citations.quote: Create custom dashboards with metrics from any service.
All logs in one place. Spot issues without switching tools.
